parsed_result.rationale: Reference graph support is centered in src/indexer/references.rs and src/indexer/mod.rs: symbols and import aliases become candidate names, references are extracted with tree-sitter or a stripped-text fallback, edges are classified as call vs reference, then resolved to source_symbol_id, target_symbol_id, and target_path. src/store/mod.rs defines the compact ReferenceRecord schema and load normalization. src/query/mod.rs builds lookup maps by source/target path and symbol, uses them for calls, called_by, references, related_tests, blast_radius, graph boosts, focus output, related output, tests output, and compact call_paths. src/cli/mod.rs exposes these through symbol, focus, related, tests, query, context, and agent-context commands, with src/main.rs dispatching CLI execution. tests/cli.rs verifies symbol calls, context graph hints, related tests, focus caller/callee edges, optional non-call references, and related/tests commands. src/indexer/lsp.rs optionally enriches indexed references with LSP references, definitions, implementations, and type definitions, merged by src/indexer/mod.rs with higher-confidence LSP edges preferred.
